items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think… I think Red came in for Shorty or came in for Conte or something like that... the guys in the Second Herd didn't want it... I think that's the best white band that ever played music... you’ve got Stan Fishelson, Bernie Glow, Shorty [Rogers], Conte [Candoli] and... Red Rodney.

ctx.x: I think… I think Red came in for Shorty or came in for Conte or something like that.
